mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past two quarters indicates strong economic growth, which is positive for corporate earnings and thus leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which is positive for consumer spending and thus leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month AND UNRATE < previous month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS and UNRATE both improve.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, which is positive for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals increased demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST MoM > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS MoM < -2%.
